[676](#676)
[677](#677)fn has_unresolved_generic_param(ty: &Type) -> bool {
[678](#678)    match ty {
[679](#679)        Type::Ident { name, params } => {
[680](#680)            if params.is_empty() {
[681](#681)                name.chars().next().map(|ch| ch.is_ascii_uppercase()).unwrap_or(false)
[682](#682)            } else {
[683](#683)                params.iter().any(has_unresolved_generic_param)
[684](#684)            }
[685](#685)        }
[686](#686)        Type::Struct { params, fields } => params.iter().any(has_unresolved_generic_param) || fields.iter().any(|(_, ty)| has_unresolved_generic_param(ty)),
[687](#687)        Type::Tuple(items) => items.iter().any(has_unresolved_generic_param),
[688](#688)        Type::List(elem) | Type::Vec(elem, _) | Type::Array(elem, _) => has_unresolved_generic_param(elem),
[689](#689)        Type::ArrayParam(elem, len) => has_unresolved_generic_param(elem) || has_unresolved_generic_param(len),
[690](#690)        Type::Fn { tys, ret } => tys.iter().any(has_unresolved_generic_param) || has_unresolved_generic_param(ret),
[691](#691)        Type::Symbol { params, .. } => params.iter().any(has_unresolved_generic_param),
[692](#692)        Type::ConstBinary { left, right, .. } => has_unresolved_generic_param(left) || has_unresolved_generic_param(right),
[693](#693)        _ => false,
[694](#694)    }
[695](#695)}
[696](#696)
[697](#697)fn is_top_level_import_expr(expr: &Expr) -> bool {
[698](#698)    matches!(
[699](#699)        &expr.kind,
[700](#700)        ExprKind::Call { obj, .. } if matches!(&obj.kind, ExprKind::Ident(name) if name.as_str() == "import")
[701](#701)    )
[702](#702)}
[703](#703)
[704](#704)fn string_value(expr: &Expr) -> Option<&str> {
[705](#705)    if let ExprKind::Value(Dynamic::String(value)) = &expr.kind { Some(value.as_str()) } else { None }
[706](#706)}
[707](#707)
[708](#708)fn import_decl(stmt: &Stmt) -> Option<(SmolStr, SmolStr)> {
[709](#709)    match &stmt.kind {
[710](#710)        StmtKind::Import { module, path, .. } => Some((module.clone(), path.clone())),
[711](#711)        StmtKind::Expr(expr, _) => {
[712](#712)            let ExprKind::Call { obj, params } = &expr.kind else {
[714](#714)                return None;
[715](#715)            };
[716](#716)            let ExprKind::Ident(name) = &obj.kind else {
[717](#717)                return None;
[718](#718)            };
[719](#719)            if name.as_str() != "import" {
[720](#720)                return None;
[721](#721)            }
[722](#722)            match params.as_slice() {
[723](#723)                [module, path] => Some((string_value(module)?.into(), string_value(path)?.into())),
[724](#724)                [module] => match &module.kind {
[725](#725)                    ExprKind::Value(Dynamic::String(value)) => Some((value.clone(), format!("{value}.zs").into())),
[726](#726)                    ExprKind::Ident(value) => Some((value.clone(), format!("{value}.zs").into())),
[727](#727)                    _ => None,
[728](#728)                },
[729](#729)                _ => None,
[730](#730)            }
[731](#731)        }
[732](#732)        _ => None,
[733](#733)    }
[734](#734)}
[735](#735)
[736](#736)fn generic_arg_for_name<'a>(name: &str, params: &'a [Type], args: &'a [Type]) -> Option<&'a Type> {
[737](#737)    params.iter().position(|param| matches!(param, Type::Ident { name: param_name, params } if params.is_empty() && param_name == name)).and_then(|idx| args.get(idx))
[738](#738)}
[739](#739)
[740](#740)pub fn infer_generic_args_from_types(generic_params: &[Type], decl_tys: &[Type], arg_tys: &[Type]) -> Vec<Type> {
[741](#741)    if generic_params.is_empty() {
[742](#742)        return Vec::new();
[743](#743)    }
[744](#744)    let mut inferred = vec![None; generic_params.len()];
[745](#745)    for (decl, actual) in decl_tys.iter().zip(arg_tys.iter()) {
[746](#746)        infer_generic_arg_from_type(generic_params, decl, actual, &mut inferred);
[747](#747)    }
[748](#748)    if inferred.iter().all(|item| item.is_some()) {
[749](#749)        return inferred.into_iter().map(Option::unwrap).collect();
[750](#750)    }
[751](#751)    if let Some(Type::Struct { params, .. }) = arg_tys.iter().find(|ty| matches!(ty, Type::Struct { params, .. } if params.len() == generic_params.len())) {
[752](#752)        return params.clone();
[753](#753)    }
[754](#754)    for (decl, actual) in decl_tys.iter().zip(arg_tys.iter()) {
[755](#755)        if let (Type::Ident { params: decl_params, .. }, Type::Ident { params: actual_params, .. }) = (decl, actual)
[756](#756)            && decl_params.len() == actual_params.len()
[757](#757)            && decl_params.iter().any(|param| generic_params.contains(param))
[758](#758)        {
[759](#759)            return actual_params.clone();
[760](#760)        }
[761](#761)    }
[762](#762)    Vec::new()
[763](#763)}
[764](#764)
[765](#765)pub fn resolve_generic_args_from_types(generic_params: &[Type], decl_tys: &[Type], arg_tys: &[Type], explicit_args: &[Type]) -> Result<Vec<Type>> {
[766](#766)    if generic_params.is_empty() {
[767](#767)        if explicit_args.is_empty() {
[768](#768)            return Ok(Vec::new());
[769](#769)        }
[770](#770)        return Err(anyhow!("函数不接受范型参数，但传入了 {}", explicit_args.len()));
[771](#771)    }
[772](#772)    if !explicit_args.is_empty() {
[773](#773)        if explicit_args.len() == generic_params.len() {
[774](#774)            return Ok(explicit_args.to_vec());
[775](#775)        }
[776](#776)        return Err(anyhow!("函数范型参数数量不匹配，期望 {} 个，实际 {} 个", generic_params.len(), explicit_args.len()));
[777](#777)    }
[778](#778)
[779](#779)    let inferred = infer_generic_args_from_types(generic_params, decl_tys, arg_tys);
[780](#780)    if inferred.len() == generic_params.len() {
[781](#781)        Ok(inferred)
[782](#782)    } else if generic_params.len() == 1
[783](#783)        && let Some(Type::List(elem) | Type::Vec(elem, _) | Type::Array(elem, _)) = arg_tys.first()
[784](#784)    {
[785](#785)        Ok(vec![elem.as_ref().clone()])
[786](#786)    } else {
[787](#787)        Err(anyhow!("无法从实参类型推断函数范型参数 {:?}", generic_params))
[788](#788)    }
[789](#789)}
[790](#790)
[791](#791)fn infer_generic_arg_from_type(generic_params: &[Type], decl: &Type, actual: &Type, inferred: &mut [Option<Type>]) {
[792](#792)    if let Some(idx) = generic_params.iter().position(|param| param == decl) {
[793](#793)        inferred[idx] = Some(actual.clone());
[794](#794)        return;
[795](#795)    }
[796](#796)
[797](#797)    match (decl, actual) {
[798](#798)        (Type::List(decl_elem), Type::List(actual_elem)) => {
[799](#799)            infer_generic_arg_from_type(generic_params, decl_elem, actual_elem, inferred);
[800](#800)        }
[801](#801)        (Type::Vec(decl_elem, decl_len), Type::Vec(actual_elem, actual_len)) | (Type::Array(decl_elem, decl_len), Type::Array(actual_elem, actual_len)) => {
[802](#802)            infer_generic_arg_from_type(generic_params, decl_elem, actual_elem, inferred);
[803](#803)            infer_generic_arg_from_type(generic_params, &Type::ConstInt(*decl_len as i64), &Type::ConstInt(*actual_len as i64), inferred);
[804](#804)        }
[805](#805)        (Type::ArrayParam(decl_elem, decl_len), Type::Array(actual_elem, actual_len)) => {
[806](#806)            infer_generic_arg_from_type(generic_params, decl_elem, actual_elem, inferred);
[807](#807)            infer_generic_arg_from_type(generic_params, decl_len, &Type::ConstInt(*actual_len as i64), inferred);
[808](#808)        }
[809](#809)        (Type::Ident { params: decl_params, .. }, Type::Ident { params: actual_params, .. })
[810](#810)        | (Type::Ident { params: decl_params, .. }, Type::Symbol { params: actual_params, .. })
[811](#811)        | (Type::Symbol { params: decl_params, .. }, Type::Symbol { params: actual_params, .. })
[812](#812)        | (Type::Symbol { params: decl_params, .. }, Type::Ident { params: actual_params, .. })
[813](#813)        | (Type::Struct { params: decl_params, .. }, Type::Struct { params: actual_params, .. }) => {
[814](#814)            for (decl, actual) in decl_params.iter().zip(actual_params.iter()) {
[815](#815)                infer_generic_arg_from_type(generic_params, decl, actual, inferred);
[816](#816)            }
[817](#817)        }
[818](#818)        _ => {}
[819](#819)    }
[820](#820)}
[821](#821)
[822](#822)fn substitute_pattern(pattern: &Pattern, params: &[Type], args: &[Type]) -> Pattern {
[823](#823)    let kind = match &pattern.kind {
[824](#824)        PatternKind::Ident { name, ty } => PatternKind::Ident { name: name.clone(), ty: substitute_type(ty, params, args) },
[825](#825)        PatternKind::Var { idx, ty } => PatternKind::Var { idx: *idx, ty: substitute_type(ty, params, args) },
[826](#826)        PatternKind::Tuple(items) => PatternKind::Tuple(items.iter().map(|item| substitute_pattern(item, params, args)).collect()),
[827](#827)        PatternKind::List { elems, has_rest } => PatternKind::List { elems: elems.iter().map(|item| substitute_pattern(item, params, args)).collect(), has_rest: *has_rest },
[828](#828)        other => other.clone(),
[829](#829)    };
[830](#830)    Pattern { kind, span: pattern.span }
[831](#831)}
[832](#832)
[833](#833)fn substitute_expr(expr: &Expr, params: &[Type], args: &[Type]) -> Expr {
[834](#834)    let kind = match &expr.kind {
[835](#835)        ExprKind::Ident(name) => match generic_arg_for_name(name, params, args) {
[836](#836)            Some(Type::ConstInt(value)) => ExprKind::Value(Dynamic::I32(*value as i32)),
[837](#837)            Some(ty) => eval_const_int_type(ty).map(|value| ExprKind::Value(Dynamic::I32(value as i32))).unwrap_or_else(|| expr.kind.clone()),
[838](#838)            _ => expr.kind.clone(),
[839](#839)        },
[840](#840)        ExprKind::Typed { value, ty } => ExprKind::Typed { value: Box::new(substitute_expr(value, params, args)), ty: substitute_type(ty, params, args) },
[841](#841)        ExprKind::Unary { op, value } => ExprKind::Unary { op: op.clone(), value: Box::new(substitute_expr(value, params, args)) },
[842](#842)        ExprKind::Binary { left, op, right } => ExprKind::Binary { left: Box::new(substitute_expr(left, params, args)), op: op.clone(), right: Box::new(substitute_expr(right, params, args)) },
[843](#843)        ExprKind::Generic { obj, params: nested } => ExprKind::Generic { obj: Box::new(substitute_expr(obj, params, args)), params: nested.iter().map(|param| substitute_type(param, params, args)).collect() },
[844](#844)        ExprKind::Assoc { ty, name } => ExprKind::Assoc { ty: substitute_type(ty, params, args), name: name.clone() },
[845](#845)        ExprKind::TypedMethod { obj, ty, name } => ExprKind::TypedMethod { obj: Box::new(substitute_expr(obj, params, args)), ty: substitute_type(ty, params, args), name: name.clone() },
[846](#846)        ExprKind::AssocId { id, params: nested } => ExprKind::AssocId { id: *id, params: nested.iter().map(|param| substitute_type(param, params, args)).collect() },
[847](#847)        ExprKind::Tuple(items) => ExprKind::Tuple(items.iter().map(|item| substitute_expr(item, params, args)).collect()),
[848](#848)        ExprKind::List(items) => ExprKind::List(items.iter().map(|item| substitute_expr(item, params, args)).collect()),
[849](#849)        ExprKind::Repeat { value, len } => ExprKind::Repeat { value: Box::new(substitute_expr(value, params, args)), len: substitute_type(len, params, args) },
[850](#850)        ExprKind::Dict(items) => ExprKind::Dict(items.iter().map(|(name, value)| (name.clone(), substitute_expr(value, params, args))).collect()),
[851](#851)        ExprKind::Range { start, stop, inclusive } => ExprKind::Range { start: Box::new(substitute_expr(start, params, args)), stop: Box::new(substitute_expr(stop, params, args)), inclusive: *inclusive },
[852](#852)        ExprKind::Call { obj, params: call_params } => ExprKind::Call { obj: Box::new(substitute_expr(obj, params, args)), params: call_params.iter().map(|param| substitute_expr(param, params, args)).collect() },
[853](#853)        ExprKind::Stmt(stmt) => ExprKind::Stmt(Box::new(substitute_stmt(stmt, params, args))),
[854](#854)        ExprKind::Closure { args: closure_args, body } => {
[855](#855)            ExprKind::Closure { args: closure_args.iter().map(|(name, ty)| (name.clone(), substitute_type(ty, params, args))).collect(), body: Box::new(substitute_stmt(body, params, args)) }
[856](#856)        }
[857](#857)        _ => expr.kind.clone(),
[858](#858)    };
[859](#859)    Expr::new(kind, expr.span)
[860](#860)}
[861](#861)
[862](#862)pub fn substitute_stmt(stmt: &Stmt, params: &[Type], args: &[Type]) -> Stmt {
[863](#863)    let kind = match &stmt.kind {
[864](#864)        StmtKind::Let { pat, value } => StmtKind::Let { pat: substitute_pattern(pat, params, args), value: Box::new(substitute_stmt(value, params, args)) },
[865](#865)        StmtKind::Expr(expr, close) => StmtKind::Expr(substitute_expr(expr, params, args), *close),
[866](#866)        StmtKind::Block(stmts) => StmtKind::Block(stmts.iter().map(|stmt| substitute_stmt(stmt, params, args)).collect()),
[867](#867)        StmtKind::Return(expr) => StmtKind::Return(expr.as_ref().map(|expr| substitute_expr(expr, params, args))),
[868](#868)        StmtKind::While { cond, body } => StmtKind::While { cond: substitute_expr(cond, params, args), body: Box::new(substitute_stmt(body, params, args)) },
[869](#869)        StmtKind::Loop(body) => StmtKind::Loop(Box::new(substitute_stmt(body, params, args))),
[870](#870)        StmtKind::For { pat, range, body } => StmtKind::For { pat: substitute_pattern(pat, params, args), range: substitute_expr(range, params, args), body: Box::new(substitute_stmt(body, params, args)) },
[871](#871)        StmtKind::Fn { name, generic_params, args: fn_args, body, is_pub } => StmtKind::Fn {
[872](#872)            name: name.clone(),
[873](#873)            generic_params: generic_params.iter().map(|param| substitute_type(param, params, args)).collect(),
[874](#874)            args: fn_args.iter().map(|(name, ty)| (name.clone(), substitute_type(ty, params, args))).collect(),
[875](#875)            body: Box::new(substitute_stmt(body, params, args)),
[876](#876)            is_pub: *is_pub,
[877](#877)        },
[878](#878)        StmtKind::Struct { name, def, is_pub } => StmtKind::Struct { name: name.clone(), def: substitute_type(def, params, args), is_pub: *is_pub },
[879](#879)        StmtKind::Impl { target, body } => StmtKind::Impl { target: substitute_type(target, params, args), body: Box::new(substitute_stmt(body, params, args)) },
[880](#880)        StmtKind::If { cond, then_body, else_body } => StmtKind::If {
[881](#881)            cond: substitute_expr(cond, params, args),
[882](#882)            then_body: Box::new(substitute_stmt(then_body, params, args)),
[883](#883)            else_body: else_body.as_ref().map(|body| Box::new(substitute_stmt(body, params, args))),
[884](#884)        },
[885](#885)        StmtKind::Static { name, ty, value, is_pub } => {
[886](#886)            StmtKind::Static { name: name.clone(), ty: substitute_type(ty, params, args), value: value.as_ref().map(|value| substitute_expr(value, params, args)), is_pub: *is_pub }
[887](#887)        }
[888](#888)        StmtKind::Const { name, ty, value, is_pub } => StmtKind::Const { name: name.clone(), ty: substitute_type(ty, params, args), value: substitute_expr(value, params, args), is_pub: *is_pub },
[889](#889)        other => other.clone(),
[890](#890)    };
[891](#891)    Stmt::new(kind, stmt.span)
[892](#892)}

[982](#982)    fn normalize_self_assign(left: Expr, op: BinaryOp, right: Expr, span: Span, arg_count: usize) -> Expr {
[983](#983)        if let Some(idx) = left.var()
[984](#984)            && (idx as usize) < arg_count
[985](#985)        {
[986](#986)            let base_op = match op {
[987](#987)                BinaryOp::AddAssign => Some(BinaryOp::Add),
[988](#988)                BinaryOp::SubAssign => Some(BinaryOp::Sub),
[989](#989)                BinaryOp::MulAssign => Some(BinaryOp::Mul),
[990](#990)                BinaryOp::DivAssign => Some(BinaryOp::Div),
[991](#991)                BinaryOp::ModAssign => Some(BinaryOp::Mod),
[992](#992)                BinaryOp::ShlAssign => Some(BinaryOp::Shl),
[993](#993)                BinaryOp::ShrAssign => Some(BinaryOp::Shr),
[994](#994)                BinaryOp::BitAndAssign => Some(BinaryOp::BitAnd),
[995](#995)                BinaryOp::BitOrAssign => Some(BinaryOp::BitOr),
[996](#996)                BinaryOp::BitXorAssign => Some(BinaryOp::BitXor),
[997](#997)                _ => None,
[998](#998)            };
[999](#999)            if let Some(op) = base_op {
[1000](#1000)                let right = Expr::new(ExprKind::Binary { left: Box::new(left.clone()), op, right: Box::new(right) }, span);
[1001](#1001)                return Expr::new(ExprKind::Binary { left: Box::new(left), op: BinaryOp::Assign, right: Box::new(right) }, span);
[1002](#1002)            }
[1003](#1003)        }
[1004](#1004)        if op == BinaryOp::Assign
[1005](#1005)            && let Some(idx) = left.var()
[1006](#1006)            && idx as usize >= arg_count
[1007](#1007)            && let ExprKind::Binary { left: rhs_left, op: rhs_op, right: rhs_right } = &right.kind
[1008](#1008)            && rhs_left.var() == Some(idx)
[1009](#1009)        {
[1010](#1010)            let compound_op = match rhs_op {
[1011](#1011)                BinaryOp::Add => Some(BinaryOp::AddAssign),
[1012](#1012)                BinaryOp::Sub => Some(BinaryOp::SubAssign),
[1013](#1013)                BinaryOp::Mul => Some(BinaryOp::MulAssign),
[1014](#1014)                BinaryOp::Div => Some(BinaryOp::DivAssign),
[1015](#1015)                BinaryOp::Mod => Some(BinaryOp::ModAssign),
[1016](#1016)                BinaryOp::Shl => Some(BinaryOp::ShlAssign),
[1017](#1017)                BinaryOp::Shr => Some(BinaryOp::ShrAssign),
[1018](#1018)                BinaryOp::BitAnd => Some(BinaryOp::BitAndAssign),
[1019](#1019)                BinaryOp::BitOr => Some(BinaryOp::BitOrAssign),
[1020](#1020)                BinaryOp::BitXor => Some(BinaryOp::BitXorAssign),
[1021](#1021)                _ => None,
[1022](#1022)            };
[1023](#1023)            if let Some(op) = compound_op {
[1024](#1024)                return Expr::new(ExprKind::Binary { left: Box::new(left), op, right: Box::new((**rhs_right).clone()) }, span);
[1025](#1025)            }
[1026](#1026)        }
[1027](#1027)        Expr::new(ExprKind::Binary { left: Box::new(left), op, right: Box::new(right) }, span)
[1028](#1028)    }

[1281](#1281)    }

[1336](#1336)    fn field_access_expr(&mut self, left: Expr, idx: usize, ty: Type, key: &str, span: Span) -> Expr {

[1343](#1343)            Expr::new(ExprKind::Binary { left: Box::new(left), op: BinaryOp::Idx, right: Box::new(right) }, span)
[1344](#1344)        } else {
[1345](#1345)            Expr::new(ExprKind::Binary { left: Box::new(left), op: BinaryOp::Idx, right: Box::new(Expr::new(ExprKind::Value(Dynamic::U32(idx as u32)), span)) }, span)

[1370](#1370)    fn method_call_obj_expr(&mut self, obj: &Expr, stmts: &mut Vec<Stmt>, cap: &mut Capture) -> Result<Option<Expr>> {

[1372](#1372)            let left = self.eval(left, stmts, cap)?;
[1373](#1373)            let base_name = match ty {
[1374](#1374)                Type::Ident { name, .. } => name.clone(),
[1375](#1375)                Type::Symbol { id, .. } => self.sym_tab.symbols.get_symbol(*id)?.0.clone(),
[1376](#1376)                _ => return Err(Self::semantic_error(obj.span, format!("方法调用类型提示必须是类型: {:?}", ty))),

[1381](#1381)        }

[1384](#1384)            return Ok(None);

[1386](#1386)        let Some(method) = self.get_value(right).and_then(|v| if v.is_str() { Some(v.as_str().to_string()) } else { None }) else {

[1395](#1395)        }

[1397](#1397)    }

[1399](#1399)    pub fn compile_fn(&mut self, args: &[SmolStr], tys: &mut Vec<Type>, body: Stmt, cap: &mut Capture) -> Result<Vec<Stmt>> {
[1400](#1400)        let top = self.sym_tab.tys.len();
[1401](#1401)        self.sym_tab.frames.push(top);
[1402](#1402)        self.type_ctx.arg_counts.push(args.len());
[1403](#1403)        let result = (|| -> Result<Vec<Stmt>> {
[1404](#1404)            for (arg, ty) in args.iter().zip(tys.iter_mut()) {
[1405](#1405)                *ty = self.sym_tab.symbols.get_type(ty)?;
[1406](#1406)                self.add_name(arg.clone());
[1407](#1407)                self.add_ty(ty.clone());
[1408](#1408)            }
[1409](#1409)            if cap.names.is_empty() && tys.iter().all(|ty| !ty.is_any()) {
[1410](#1410)                let saved_state = (self.sym_tab.frames.clone(), self.sym_tab.names.clone(), self.sym_tab.tys.clone(), self.type_ctx.list_elem_states.clone(), self.type_ctx.arg_counts.clone());

[1412](#1412)                self.restore_local_state(saved_state);
[1413](#1413)                result?;
[1414](#1414)            }
[1415](#1415)            let mut compiled = Vec::new();
[1416](#1416)            self.compile_stmt(body, &mut compiled, cap)?;
[1417](#1417)            if !compiled.last_mut().map(|stmt| stmt.last_return()).unwrap_or(false) {
[1418](#1418)                compiled.push(Stmt::new(StmtKind::Return(None), Span::default()));
[1419](#1419)            }
[1420](#1420)            Ok(compiled)
[1421](#1421)        })();
[1422](#1422)        if let Some(top) = self.sym_tab.frames.pop() {
[1423](#1423)            self.sym_tab.tys.truncate(top);
[1424](#1424)            self.sym_tab.names.truncate(top);
[1425](#1425)            self.type_ctx.list_elem_states.truncate(top);
[1426](#1426)        }
[1427](#1427)        self.type_ctx.arg_counts.pop();
[1428](#1428)        result
[1429](#1429)    }

[1431](#1431)    pub fn compile(&mut self, mod_name: SmolStr, stmts: Vec<Stmt>) -> Result<Vec<u32>> {
[1432](#1432)        self.sym_tab.symbols.add_module(mod_name.clone());
[1433](#1433)        for stmt in stmts {
[1434](#1434)            match stmt.kind {
[1435](#1435)                StmtKind::Struct { name, def, is_pub } => {
[1436](#1436)                    self.sym_tab.symbols.add(name, Symbol::Struct(def, is_pub));
[1437](#1437)                }
[1438](#1438)                StmtKind::Static { name, ty, value, is_pub } => {
[1439](#1439)                    let value = value.map(|value| self.const_expr_value(&value)).transpose()?;
[1440](#1440)                    self.sym_tab.symbols.add(name, Symbol::Static { value, ty, is_pub });
[1441](#1441)                }
[1442](#1442)                StmtKind::Const { name, ty, value, is_pub } => {
[1443](#1443)                    let value = self.const_expr_value(&value)?;
[1444](#1444)                    let ty = if ty.is_any() { value.get_type() } else { ty };
[1445](#1445)                    self.sym_tab.symbols.add(name, Symbol::Const { value, ty, is_pub });

[1516](#1516)    fn pat_to_var(&mut self, pat: Pattern, expr_ty: Type) -> Result<Pattern> {

[1555](#1555)        }

[1625](#1625)    fn lower_multi_assign(&mut self, left: &Expr, right: &Expr, stmts: &mut Vec<Stmt>, cap: &mut Capture, span: Span) -> Result<Expr> {

[1629](#1629)        };

[1632](#1632)        }
[1633](#1633)

[1643](#1643)                Self::push_assign(stmts, temp.clone(), Self::typed_expr(value, &ty), item.span);
[1644](#1644)                temps.push((temp, ty));
[1645](#1645)            }
[1646](#1646)        } else {
[1647](#1647)            let value = self.eval(right, stmts, cap)?;
[1648](#1648)            let ty = self.infer_expr(&value)?;
[1649](#1649)            let source = self.temp_var(ty.clone(), right.span);
[1650](#1650)            Self::push_assign(stmts, source.clone(), Self::typed_expr(value, &ty), right.span);
[1651](#1651)            for idx in 0..left_items.len() {
[1652](#1652)                let item_span = left_items[idx].span;
[1653](#1653)                let item = Expr::new(ExprKind::Binary { left: Box::new(source.clone()), op: BinaryOp::Idx, right: Box::new(Expr::new(ExprKind::Value((idx as u32).into()), item_span)) }, item_span);
[1654](#1654)                let value = self.eval(&item, stmts, cap)?;
[1655](#1655)                let ty = self.infer_expr(&value)?;
[1656](#1656)                let temp = self.temp_var(ty.clone(), item_span);
[1657](#1657)                Self::push_assign(stmts, temp.clone(), Self::typed_expr(value, &ty), item_span);

[1659](#1659)            }
[1660](#1660)        }
[1661](#1661)
[1662](#1662)        for (target, (temp, ty)) in left_items.iter().zip(temps.iter()) {

[1706](#1706)    fn const_expr_value(&self, expr: &Expr) -> Result<Dynamic> {
[1707](#1707)        match &expr.kind {
[1708](#1708)            ExprKind::Value(value) => Ok(value.clone()),
[1709](#1709)            ExprKind::Const(idx) => self.sym_tab.consts.get_index(*idx).map(|(_, v)| v.clone()).ok_or_else(|| Self::semantic_error(expr.span, format!("常量索引 {} 不存在", idx))),

[1711](#1711)                let id = self.sym_tab.symbols.get_id(ident).map_err(|_| Self::semantic_error(expr.span, format!("未找到常量 {}", ident)))?;

[1714](#1714)                    Ok(Symbol::Static { value: Some(value), .. }) => Ok(value.clone()),
[1715](#1715)                    _ => Err(Self::semantic_error(expr.span, format!("{} 不是可用于 const 的静态值", ident))),
[1716](#1716)                }
[1717](#1717)            }
[1718](#1718)            ExprKind::Typed { value, ty } if ty.is_native() => Ok(ty.force(self.const_expr_value(value)?)?),
[1719](#1719)            ExprKind::Typed { value, .. } => self.const_expr_value(value),
[1720](#1720)            ExprKind::List(items) | ExprKind::Tuple(items) => {
[1721](#1721)                let values = items.iter().map(|item| self.const_expr_value(item)).collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;

[1723](#1723)            }
[1724](#1724)            ExprKind::Dict(items) => {
[1725](#1725)                let mut values = BTreeMap::new();
[1726](#1726)                for (key, item) in items {
[1727](#1727)                    values.insert(key.clone(), self.const_expr_value(item)?);
[1728](#1728)                }
[1729](#1729)                Ok(Dynamic::map(values))
[1730](#1730)            }
[1731](#1731)            ExprKind::Unary { op, value } => {
[1732](#1732)                let value = self.const_expr_value(value)?;
[1733](#1733)                match op {
[1734](#1734)                    parser::UnaryOp::Neg => Ok(-value),
[1735](#1735)                    parser::UnaryOp::Not => Ok(!value),
[1736](#1736)                    parser::UnaryOp::Unknow => Err(Self::semantic_error(expr.span, "const 一元表达式无法在编译期求值")),
[1737](#1737)                }
[1738](#1738)            }
[1739](#1739)            ExprKind::Binary { left, op, right } => {
[1740](#1740)                let left = Expr::new(ExprKind::Value(self.const_expr_value(left)?), left.span);
[1741](#1741)                let right = Expr::new(ExprKind::Value(self.const_expr_value(right)?), right.span);
[1742](#1742)                Expr::new(ExprKind::Binary { left: Box::new(left), op: op.clone(), right: Box::new(right) }, expr.span).compact().ok_or_else(|| Self::semantic_error(expr.span, "const 二元表达式无法在编译期求值"))
[1743](#1743)            }
[1744](#1744)            _ => Err(Self::semantic_error(expr.span, "const 只能使用字面量、已声明常量和静态 composite literal")),
[1745](#1745)        }
[1746](#1746)    }

[1758](#1758)    fn eval(&mut self, expr: &Expr, stmts: &mut Vec<Stmt>, cap: &mut Capture) -> Result<Expr> {

[2104](#2104)            StmtKind::Return(expr) => {
[2105](#2105)                let expr = expr.map(|e| self.eval(&e, compiled, cap)).transpose()?;
[2106](#2106)                compiled.push(Stmt::new(StmtKind::Return(expr), stmt_span));
[2107](#2107)            }
[2108](#2108)            StmtKind::If { cond, then_body, else_body } => {
[2109](#2109)                let cond = self.eval(&cond, compiled, cap)?;
[2110](#2110)                if let Some(cond_value) = cond.compact()
[2111](#2111)                    && let Some(cond_bool) = cond_value.as_bool()
[2112](#2112)                {
[2113](#2113)                    if cond_bool {
[2114](#2114)                        self.compile_stmt(*then_body, compiled, cap)?;
[2115](#2115)                    } else if let Some(body) = else_body {
[2116](#2116)                        self.compile_stmt(*body, compiled, cap)?;
[2117](#2117)                    }
[2118](#2118)                } else {
[2119](#2119)                    let then_body = Box::new(self.get_stmt(*then_body, cap)?);
[2120](#2120)                    let else_body = if let Some(body) = else_body { Some(Box::new(self.get_stmt(*body, cap)?)) } else { None };
[2121](#2121)                    compiled.push(Stmt::new(StmtKind::If { cond, then_body, else_body }, stmt_span));
[2122](#2122)                }
[2123](#2123)            }
[2124](#2124)            StmtKind::Loop(body) => {
[2125](#2125)                compiled.push(Stmt::new(StmtKind::Loop(Box::new(self.get_stmt(*body, cap)?)), stmt_span));
[2126](#2126)            }
[2127](#2127)            StmtKind::While { cond, body } => {
[2128](#2128)                let cond = self.eval(&cond, compiled, cap)?;
[2129](#2129)                compiled.push(Stmt::new(StmtKind::While { cond, body: Box::new(self.get_stmt(*body, cap)?) }, stmt_span));
[2130](#2130)            }
[2131](#2131)            StmtKind::For { pat, range, body } => {
[2132](#2132)                let range = self.eval(&range, compiled, cap)?;
[2133](#2133)                let range_ty = self.infer_range_type(&range);
[2134](#2134)                let pat = self.pat_to_var(pat, range_ty)?;
[2135](#2135)                compiled.push(Stmt::new(StmtKind::For { pat, range, body: Box::new(self.get_stmt(*body, cap)?) }, stmt_span));
[2136](#2136)            }
[2137](#2137)            stmt_kind => {
[2138](#2138)                compiled.push(Stmt::new(stmt_kind, stmt_span));
[2139](#2139)            }
[2140](#2140)        }
[2141](#2141)        Ok(())
[2142](#2142)    }
[2143](#2143)}

}## Expand description

编译器的类型推导状态。推导逻辑(类型推导栈、列表元素状态、参数计数等)集中在这里, 改推导算法时只需读这个文件,不会被符号表或 IO 状态干扰。

# num_enum - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/num_enum/^0.7.6/

## Expand description

[§](https://docs.rs#num_enum)num_enum

Procedural macros to make inter-operation between primitives and enums easier. This crate is no_std compatible.

[§](https://docs.rs#turning-an-enum-into-a-primitive)Turning an enum into a primitive

```
use num_enum::IntoPrimitive;
#[derive(IntoPrimitive)]
#[repr(u8)]
enum Number {
    Zero,
    One,
}
fn main() {
    let zero: u8 = Number::Zero.into();
    assert_eq!(zero, 0u8);
}
```
`num_enum`’s `IntoPrimitive` is more type-safe than using `as`, because `as` will silently truncate - `num_enum` only derives `From` for exactly the discriminant type of the enum.

[§](https://docs.rs#attempting-to-turn-a-primitive-into-an-enum-with-try_from)Attempting to turn a primitive into an enum with try_from

```
use num_enum::TryFromPrimitive;
use std::convert::TryFrom;
#[derive(Debug, Eq, PartialEq, TryFromPrimitive)]
#[repr(u8)]
enum Number {
    Zero,
    One,
}
fn main() {
    let zero = Number::try_from(0u8);
    assert_eq!(zero, Ok(Number::Zero));
    let three = Number::try_from(3u8);
    assert_eq!(
        three.unwrap_err().to_string(),
        "No discriminant in enum `Number` matches the value `3`",
    );
}
```
[§](https://docs.rs#variant-alternatives)Variant alternatives

Sometimes a single enum variant might be representable by multiple numeric values.

The `#[num_enum(alternatives = [..])]` attribute allows you to define additional value alternatives for individual variants.

(The behavior of `IntoPrimitive` is unaffected by this attribute, it will always return the canonical value.)

```
use num_enum::TryFromPrimitive;
use std::convert::TryFrom;
#[derive(Debug, Eq, PartialEq, TryFromPrimitive)]
#[repr(u8)]
enum Number {
    Zero = 0,
    #[num_enum(alternatives = [2])]
    OneOrTwo = 1,
}
fn main() {
    let zero = Number::try_from(0u8);
    assert_eq!(zero, Ok(Number::Zero));
    let one = Number::try_from(1u8);
    assert_eq!(one, Ok(Number::OneOrTwo));
    let two = Number::try_from(2u8);
    assert_eq!(two, Ok(Number::OneOrTwo));
    let three = Number::try_from(3u8);
    assert_eq!(
        three.unwrap_err().to_string(),
        "No discriminant in enum `Number` matches the value `3`",
    );
}
```
Range expressions are also supported for alternatives, but this requires enabling the `complex-expressions` feature:

```
use num_enum::TryFromPrimitive;
use std::convert::TryFrom;
#[derive(Debug, Eq, PartialEq, TryFromPrimitive)]
#[repr(u8)]
enum Number {
    Zero = 0,
    #[num_enum(alternatives = [2..16])]
    Some = 1,
    #[num_enum(alternatives = [17, 18..=255])]
    Many = 16,
}
fn main() {
    let zero = Number::try_from(0u8);
    assert_eq!(zero, Ok(Number::Zero));
    let some = Number::try_from(15u8);
    assert_eq!(some, Ok(Number::Some));
    let many = Number::try_from(255u8);
    assert_eq!(many, Ok(Number::Many));
}
```
[§](https://docs.rs#custom-error-types)Custom error types

`TryFromPrimitive` by default will use `num_enum::TryFromPrimitiveError` as its `Error` type.

If you want to use a different type, you can use an annotation for this:

```
use num_enum::TryFromPrimitive;
#[derive(Debug, Eq, PartialEq, TryFromPrimitive)]
#[num_enum(error_type(name = CustomError, constructor = CustomError::new))]
#[repr(u8)]
enum FirstNumber {
    Zero,
    One,
    Two,
}
struct CustomError {}
impl CustomError {
    fn new(value: u8) -> CustomError {
        CustomError {}
    }
}
```
[§](https://docs.rs#safely-turning-a-primitive-into-an-exhaustive-enum-with-from_primitive)Safely turning a primitive into an exhaustive enum with from_primitive

If your enum has all possible primitive values covered, you can derive `FromPrimitive` for it (which auto-implement stdlib’s `From`):

You can cover all possible values by:

- Having variants for every possible value
- Having a variant marked `#[num_enum(default)]`
- Having a variant marked `#[num_enum(catch_all)]`
- Having `#[num_enum(alternatives = [...])`s covering values not covered by a variant.

```
use num_enum::FromPrimitive;
#[derive(Debug, Eq, PartialEq, FromPrimitive)]
#[repr(u8)]
enum Number {
    Zero,
    #[num_enum(default)]
    NonZero,
}
fn main() {
    assert_eq!(
        Number::Zero,
        Number::from(0_u8),
    );
    assert_eq!(
        Number::NonZero,
        Number::from(1_u8),
    );
}
```
[§](https://docs.rs#default-variant)Default variant

Sometimes it is desirable to have an `Other` variant in an enum that acts as a kind of a wildcard matching all the value not yet covered by other variants.

The `#[num_enum(default)]` attribute (or the stdlib `#[default]` attribute) allows you to mark variant as the default.

(The behavior of `IntoPrimitive` is unaffected by this attribute, it will always return the canonical value.)

```
use num_enum::FromPrimitive;
use std::convert::TryFrom;
#[derive(Debug, Eq, PartialEq, FromPrimitive)]
#[repr(u8)]
enum Number {
    Zero = 0,
    #[num_enum(default)]
    NonZero = 1,
}
fn main() {
    let zero = Number::from(0u8);
    assert_eq!(zero, Number::Zero);
    let one = Number::from(1u8);
    assert_eq!(one, Number::NonZero);
    let two = Number::from(2u8);
    assert_eq!(two, Number::NonZero);
}
```
Only `FromPrimitive` pays attention to `default` attributes, `TryFromPrimitive` ignores them.

[§](https://docs.rs#catch-all-variant)Catch-all variant

Sometimes it is desirable to have an `Other` variant which holds the otherwise un-matched value as a field.

The `#[num_enum(catch_all)]` attribute allows you to mark at most one variant for this purpose. The variant it’s applied to must be a tuple variant with exactly one field matching the `repr` type.

```
use num_enum::FromPrimitive;
use std::convert::TryFrom;
#[derive(Debug, Eq, PartialEq, FromPrimitive)]
#[repr(u8)]
enum Number {
    Zero = 0,
    #[num_enum(catch_all)]
    NonZero(u8),
}
fn main() {
    let zero = Number::from(0u8);
    assert_eq!(zero, Number::Zero);
    let one = Number::from(1u8);
    assert_eq!(one, Number::NonZero(1_u8));
    let two = Number::from(2u8);
    assert_eq!(two, Number::NonZero(2_u8));
}
```
As this is naturally exhaustive, this is only supported for `FromPrimitive`, not also `TryFromPrimitive`.

[§](https://docs.rs#unsafely-turning-a-primitive-into-an-enum-with-unchecked_transmute_from)Unsafely turning a primitive into an enum with unchecked_transmute_from

If you’re really certain a conversion will succeed (and have not made use of `#[num_enum(default)]` or `#[num_enum(alternatives = [..])]`
for any of its variants), and want to avoid a small amount of overhead, you can use unsafe code to do this conversion.
Unless you have data showing that the match statement generated in the `try_from` above is a bottleneck for you,
you should avoid doing this, as the unsafe code has potential to cause serious memory issues in your program.

```
use num_enum::UnsafeFromPrimitive;
#[derive(Debug, Eq, PartialEq, UnsafeFromPrimitive)]
#[repr(u8)]
enum Number {
    Zero,
    One,
}
fn main() {
    assert_eq!(
        unsafe { Number::unchecked_transmute_from(0_u8) },
        Number::Zero,
    );
    assert_eq!(
        unsafe { Number::unchecked_transmute_from(1_u8) },
        Number::One,
    );
}
unsafe fn undefined_behavior() {
    let _ = Number::unchecked_transmute_from(2); // 2 is not a valid discriminant!
}
```
Note that this derive ignores any `default`, `catch_all`, and `alternatives` attributes on the enum.
If you need support for conversions from these values, you should use `TryFromPrimitive` or `FromPrimitive`.

This means, for instance, that the following is undefined behaviour:

```
use num_enum::UnsafeFromPrimitive;
#[derive(UnsafeFromPrimitive)]
#[repr(u8)]
enum Number {
    Zero = 0,
    // Same for `#[num_enum(catch_all)]`, and `#[num_enum(alternatives = [2, ...])]`
    #[num_enum(default)]
    One = 1,
}
let _undefined_behavior = unsafe { Number::unchecked_transmute_from(2) };
```
[§](https://docs.rs#optional-features)Optional features

Some enum values may be composed of complex expressions, for example:

```
enum Number {
    Zero = (0, 1).0,
    One = (0, 1).1,
}
```
To cut down on compile time, these are not supported by default, but if you enable the `complex-expressions`
feature of your dependency on `num_enum`, these should start working.

[§](https://docs.rs#license)License

num_enum may be used under your choice of the BSD 3-clause, Apache 2, or MIT license.

# proptest - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/proptest/^1.11.0/

## Expand description

[§](https://docs.rs#proptest-reference-documentation)Proptest Reference Documentation

This is the reference documentation for the proptest API.

For documentation on how to get started with proptest and general usage
advice, please refer to the [Proptest Book](https://proptest-rs.github.io/proptest/intro.html).

## Modules[§](https://docs.rs#modules)

- [arbitrary](https://docs.rs/arbitrary/index.html)
- Defines the `Arbitrary`trait and related free functions and type aliases.
- [array](https://docs.rs/array/index.html)
- Support for strategies producing fixed-length arrays.
- [bits](https://docs.rs/bits/index.html)
- Strategies for working with bit sets.
- [bool](https://docs.rs/bool/index.html)
- Strategies for generating `bool`values.
- [char](https://docs.rs/char/index.html)
- Strategies for generating `char`values.
- [collection](https://docs.rs/collection/index.html)
- Strategies for generating `std::collections`of values.
- [num](https://docs.rs/num/index.html)
- Strategies to generate numeric values (as opposed to integers used as bit fields).
- [option](https://docs.rs/option/index.html)
- Strategies for generating `std::Option`values.
- [path](https://docs.rs/path/index.html)- `std`
- Strategies for generating [`PathBuf`] and related path types.
- [prelude](https://docs.rs/prelude/index.html)
- Re-exports the most commonly-needed APIs of proptest.
- [range_](https://docs.rs/range_subset/index.html)- subset - `std`
- Strategies for generating values by taking samples of index ranges.
- [result](https://docs.rs/result/index.html)
- Strategies for combining delegate strategies into `std::Result`s.
- [sample](https://docs.rs/sample/index.html)
- Strategies for generating values by taking samples of collections.
- [strategy](https://docs.rs/strategy/index.html)
- Defines the core traits used by Proptest.
- [string](https://docs.rs/string/index.html)- `std`
- Strategies for generating strings and byte strings from regular expressions.
- [test_](https://docs.rs/test_runner/index.html)- runner
- State and functions for running proptest tests.
- [tuple](https://docs.rs/tuple/index.html)
- Support for combining strategies into tuples.

## Macros[§](https://docs.rs#macros)

- [prop_](https://docs.rs/macro.prop_assert.html)- assert
- Similar to `assert!`from std, but returns a test failure instead of panicking if the condition fails.
- [prop_](https://docs.rs/macro.prop_assert_eq.html)- assert_ - eq
- Similar to `assert_eq!`from std, but returns a test failure instead of panicking if the condition fails.
- [prop_](https://docs.rs/macro.prop_assert_ne.html)- assert_ - ne
- Similar to `assert_ne!`from std, but returns a test failure instead of panicking if the condition fails.
- [prop_](https://docs.rs/macro.prop_assume.html)- assume
- Rejects the test input if assumptions are not met.
- [prop_](https://docs.rs/macro.prop_compose.html)- compose
- Convenience to define functions which produce new strategies.
- [prop_](https://docs.rs/macro.prop_oneof.html)- oneof
- Produce a strategy which picks one of the listed choices.
- [proptest](https://docs.rs/macro.proptest.html)
- Easily define `proptest`tests.

## Attribute Macros[§](https://docs.rs#attributes)

- [property_](https://docs.rs/attr.property_test.html)- test - `attr-macro`
- The `property_test`procedural macro simplifies the creation of property-based tests using the`proptest`crate. This macro provides a more concise syntax for writing tests that automatically generate test cases based on properties.

- 解析递归深度上限。超过即返回 [`ParserErr::TooDeep`],把“栈溢出崩溃“降级为 普通解析错误。

[94](#94)#[macro_export]
[95](#95)macro_rules! parse_list {
[96](#96)    ($self: ident, $start: expr, $end: expr, $sep: expr, $item_expr: expr) => {{
[97](#97)        let mut items = $start;
[98](#98)        loop {
[99](#99)            $self.whitespace()?;
[100](#100)            if $self.get()? == $end {
[101](#101)                $self.pos += 1;
[102](#102)                break;
[103](#103)            }
[104](#104)            let item = $item_expr;
[105](#105)            items.push(item);
[106](#106)            $self.whitespace()?;
[107](#107)            if $self.get()? == $sep {
[108](#108)                $self.pos += 1;
[109](#109)            }
[110](#110)        }
[111](#111)        items
[112](#112)    }};
[113](#113)}

[115](#115)#[macro_export]
[116](#116)macro_rules! try_parse {
[117](#117)    ($self: ident, $method: expr) => {{
[118](#118)        let save_pos = $self.pos; let save_decl_scopes = $self.decl_scopes.clone();
[120](#120)        let save_impl_depth = $self.scope_depths.impl_depth;
[121](#121)        match $method {
[122](#122)            Ok(expr) => Ok(expr),
[123](#123)            Err(e) if $self.fatal => Err(e),
[125](#125)            Err(e) => {
[126](#126)                $self.pos = save_pos;
[127](#127)                $self.decl_scopes = save_decl_scopes;
[128](#128)                $self.scope_depths.impl_depth = save_impl_depth;
[129](#129)                Err(e)
[130](#130)            }
[131](#131)        }
[132](#132)    }};

[181](#181)    pub fn new(buf: Vec<u8>) -> Self {

[184](#184)
[185](#185)    fn enter_depth(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
[192](#192)        self.scope_depths.depth += 1;
[193](#193)        if self.scope_depths.depth > MAX_PARSE_DEPTH {
[194](#194)            self.scope_depths.depth -= 1;
[195](#195)            self.fatal = true;
[196](#196)            return Err(ParserErr::at("表达式嵌套过深", self.current_pos()).into());
[197](#197)        }
[198](#198)        Ok(())
[199](#199)    }
[200](#200)
[201](#201)    fn exit_depth(&mut self) {
[202](#202)        self.scope_depths.depth = self.scope_depths.depth.saturating_sub(1);
[203](#203)    }
[204](#204)
[205](#205)    fn check_fatal(&self) -> Result<()> {
[207](#207)        if self.fatal { Err(ParserErr::at("表达式嵌套过深", self.current_pos()).into()) } else { Ok(()) }
[208](#208)    }

[210](#210)    pub(crate) fn push_decl_scope(&mut self) {
[211](#211)        self.decl_scopes.push(BTreeSet::new());
[212](#212)    }

[214](#214)    pub(crate) fn pop_decl_scope(&mut self) {
[215](#215)        if self.decl_scopes.len() > 1 {
[216](#216)            self.decl_scopes.pop();
[217](#217)        }
[218](#218)    }
[219](#219)
[220](#220)    fn declare_symbol(&mut self, name: &SmolStr) -> Result<()> {
[221](#221)        if name.is_empty() {
[222](#222)            return Ok(());
[223](#223)        }
[224](#224)        if self.decl_scopes.iter().rev().any(|scope| scope.contains(name)) {
[225](#225)            return Err(ParserErr::at(format!("符号 {} 已经声明", name), self.current_pos()).into());
[226](#226)        }
[227](#227)        self.decl_scopes.last_mut().expect("parser always has a declaration scope").insert(name.clone());
[228](#228)        Ok(())
[229](#229)    }
[230](#230)
[231](#231)    pub(crate) fn declare_symbol_in_current_scope(&mut self, name: &SmolStr) -> Result<()> {
[232](#232)        if name.is_empty() {
[233](#233)            return Ok(());
[234](#234)        }
[235](#235)        let scope = self.decl_scopes.last_mut().expect("parser always has a declaration scope");
[236](#236)        if scope.contains(name) {
[237](#237)            return Err(ParserErr::at(format!("符号 {} 已经声明", name), self.current_pos()).into());
[238](#238)        }
[239](#239)        scope.insert(name.clone());
[240](#240)        Ok(())
[241](#241)    }
[242](#242)
[243](#243)    fn declare_function_name(&mut self, name: &SmolStr) -> Result<()> {
[244](#244)        if self.scope_depths.impl_depth > 0 { self.declare_symbol_in_current_scope(name) } else { self.declare_symbol(name) }
[245](#245)    }
[246](#246)
[247](#247)    fn declare_args(&mut self, args: &[(SmolStr, Type)]) -> Result<()> {
[248](#248)        for (name, _) in args {
[249](#249)            self.declare_symbol(name)?;
[250](#250)        }
[251](#251)        Ok(())
[252](#252)    }
[253](#253)
[254](#254)    pub(crate) fn declare_pattern_symbols(&mut self, pat: &Pattern) -> Result<()> {
[255](#255)        match &pat.kind {
[256](#256)            PatternKind::Ident { name, .. } => self.declare_symbol_in_current_scope(name),
[257](#257)            PatternKind::Tuple(items) => {
[258](#258)                for item in items {
[259](#259)                    self.declare_pattern_symbols(item)?;
[260](#260)                }
[261](#261)                Ok(())
[262](#262)            }
[263](#263)            PatternKind::List { elems, .. } => {
[264](#264)                for item in elems {
[265](#265)                    self.declare_pattern_symbols(item)?;
[266](#266)                }
[267](#267)                Ok(())
[268](#268)            }
[269](#269)            PatternKind::Struct { fields, .. } => {
[270](#270)                for (name, sub) in fields {
[271](#271)                    if let Some(sub) = sub {
[272](#272)                        self.declare_pattern_symbols(sub)?;
[273](#273)                    } else {
[274](#274)                        self.declare_symbol_in_current_scope(name)?;
[275](#275)                    }
[276](#276)                }
[277](#277)                Ok(())
[278](#278)            }
[279](#279)            PatternKind::Wildcard | PatternKind::Var { .. } | PatternKind::Literal(_) | PatternKind::Member(_, _) | PatternKind::Idx(_, _) => Ok(()),
[280](#280)        }
[281](#281)    }
[282](#282)
[283](#283)    fn function_body(&mut self, args: &[(SmolStr, Type)]) -> Result<Stmt> {
[284](#284)        self.push_decl_scope();
[285](#285)        self.scope_depths.fn_body_depth += 1;
[286](#286)        let result = (|| {
[287](#287)            self.declare_args(args)?;
[288](#288)            self.block()
[289](#289)        })();
[290](#290)        self.scope_depths.fn_body_depth -= 1;
[291](#291)        self.pop_decl_scope();
[292](#292)        result
[293](#293)    }
[294](#294)
[295](#295)    fn impl_body(&mut self) -> Result<Stmt> {
[296](#296)        self.push_decl_scope();
[297](#297)        self.scope_depths.impl_depth += 1;
[298](#298)        self.scope_depths.impl_body_depth += 1;
[299](#299)        let result = self.block();
[300](#300)        self.scope_depths.impl_body_depth -= 1;
[301](#301)        self.scope_depths.impl_depth -= 1;
[302](#302)        self.pop_decl_scope();
[303](#303)        result
[304](#304)    }

[322](#322)        }
[323](#323)    }

[352](#352)    pub fn collect<F: Fn(u8) -> bool>(&mut self, f: F) -> Result<(usize, usize)> {
[353](#353)        let start = self.pos;
[354](#354)        while self.pos < self.buf.len() && f(self.buf[self.pos]) {
[355](#355)            self.pos += 1;
[356](#356)        }
[357](#357)        if self.pos > start { Ok((start, self.pos)) } else { Err(ParserErr::at("未发现期望字符", start).into()) }
[358](#358)    }

[360](#360)    pub fn just(&mut self, pattern: &str) -> Result<()> {
[361](#361)        if self.buf.len() - self.pos >= pattern.len() && self.buf[self.pos..self.pos + pattern.len()].eq(pattern.as_bytes()) {
[362](#362)            self.pos += pattern.len();
[363](#363)            Ok(())
[364](#364)        } else {
[365](#365)            Err(ParserErr::at(format!("期望字符串 {}", pattern), self.pos).into())
[366](#366)        }
[367](#367)    }

[369](#369)    pub fn keyword(&mut self, pattern: &str) -> Result<()> {
[370](#370)        self.just(pattern)?;
[371](#371)        if self.pos < self.buf.len() && !NOT_IDENT.contains(&self.buf[self.pos]) {
[372](#372)            self.pos -= pattern.len();
[373](#373)            return Err(ParserErr::at(format!("期望字符串 {}", pattern), self.pos).into());
[374](#374)        }
[375](#375)        Ok(())
[376](#376)    }
[377](#377)
[378](#378)    pub fn get_type(&mut self) -> Result<Type> {
[379](#379)        self.whitespace()?;
[380](#380)        if self.get()? == b'[' {
[381](#381)            self.pos += 1;
[382](#382)            let ty = self.get_type()?;
[383](#383)            self.until(b';')?;
[384](#384)            self.whitespace()?;
[385](#385)            let len = self.get_type_param()?;
[386](#386)            self.until(b']')?;
[387](#387)            if let Type::ConstInt(number) = len {
[388](#388)                let number = u32::try_from(number).map_err(|_| anyhow!("数组长度超出 u32 范围"))?;
[389](#389)                Ok(Type::Array(std::rc::Rc::new(ty), number))
[390](#390)            } else {
[391](#391)                Ok(Type::ArrayParam(std::rc::Rc::new(ty), std::rc::Rc::new(len)))
[392](#392)            }
[393](#393)        } else {
[394](#394)            for ty in TYPES {
[395](#395)                if self.just(ty.0).is_ok() {
[396](#396)                    return Ok(ty.1.clone());
[397](#397)                }
[398](#398)            }
[399](#399)            let name = self.ident()?;
[400](#400)            if self.take(b'<').is_ok() {
[401](#401)                let params = crate::parse_list!(self, Vec::new(), b'>', b',', self.get_type_param()?);
[402](#402)                Ok(Type::Ident { name, params })
[403](#403)            } else {
[404](#404)                Ok(Type::Ident { name, params: Vec::new() })
[405](#405)            }
[406](#406)        }
[407](#407)    }
[408](#408)
[409](#409)    pub fn get_type_param(&mut self) -> Result<Type> {
[410](#410)        self.const_type_param_add()
[411](#411)    }
[412](#412)
[413](#413)    fn const_type_param_add(&mut self) -> Result<Type> {
[414](#414)        let mut left = self.const_type_param_mul()?;
[415](#415)        loop {
[416](#416)            self.whitespace()?;
[417](#417)            let op = if self.take(b'+').is_ok() {
[418](#418)                Some(ConstIntOp::Add)
[419](#419)            } else if self.take(b'-').is_ok() {
[420](#420)                Some(ConstIntOp::Sub)
[421](#421)            } else {
[422](#422)                None
[423](#423)            };
[424](#424)            let Some(op) = op else { break };
[425](#425)            let right = self.const_type_param_mul()?;
[426](#426)            left = Self::fold_const_type_binary(op, left, right)?;
[427](#427)        }
[428](#428)        Ok(left)
[429](#429)    }
[430](#430)
[431](#431)    fn const_type_param_mul(&mut self) -> Result<Type> {
[432](#432)        let mut left = self.const_type_param_primary()?;
[433](#433)        loop {
[434](#434)            self.whitespace()?;
[435](#435)            let op = if self.take(b'*').is_ok() {
[436](#436)                Some(ConstIntOp::Mul)
[437](#437)            } else if self.take(b'/').is_ok() {
[438](#438)                Some(ConstIntOp::Div)
[439](#439)            } else if self.take(b'%').is_ok() {
[440](#440)                Some(ConstIntOp::Mod)
[441](#441)            } else {
[442](#442)                None
[443](#443)            };
[444](#444)            let Some(op) = op else { break };
[445](#445)            let right = self.const_type_param_primary()?;
[446](#446)            left = Self::fold_const_type_binary(op, left, right)?;
[447](#447)        }
[448](#448)        Ok(left)
[449](#449)    }
[450](#450)
[451](#451)    fn const_type_param_primary(&mut self) -> Result<Type> {
[452](#452)        self.whitespace()?;
[453](#453)        if self.take(b'(').is_ok() {
[454](#454)            let ty = self.get_type_param()?;
[455](#455)            self.until(b')')?;
[456](#456)            return Ok(ty);
[457](#457)        }
[458](#458)        if self.get()?.is_ascii_digit() {
[459](#459)            let value = self.number()?;
[460](#460)            if let Some(value) = value.as_uint() {
[461](#461)                let value = i64::try_from(value).map_err(|_| anyhow!("模板数字参数超出 i64 范围"))?;
[462](#462)                Ok(Type::ConstInt(value))
[463](#463)            } else if let Some(value) = value.as_int() {
[464](#464)                Ok(Type::ConstInt(value))
[465](#465)            } else {
[466](#466)                Err(anyhow!("模板数字参数必须是整数"))
[467](#467)            }
[468](#468)        } else {
[469](#469)            self.get_type()
[470](#470)        }
[471](#471)    }
[472](#472)
[473](#473)    fn fold_const_type_binary(op: ConstIntOp, left: Type, right: Type) -> Result<Type> {
[474](#474)        if let (Type::ConstInt(left), Type::ConstInt(right)) = (&left, &right) {
[475](#475)            let value = match op {
[476](#476)                ConstIntOp::Add => left + right,
[477](#477)                ConstIntOp::Sub => left - right,
[478](#478)                ConstIntOp::Mul => left * right,
[479](#479)                ConstIntOp::Div => {
[480](#480)                    if *right == 0 {
[481](#481)                        return Err(anyhow!("模板整数除以 0"));
[482](#482)                    }
[483](#483)                    left / right
[484](#484)                }
[485](#485)                ConstIntOp::Mod => {
[486](#486)                    if *right == 0 {
[487](#487)                        return Err(anyhow!("模板整数取模 0"));
[488](#488)                    }
[489](#489)                    left % right
[490](#490)                }
[491](#491)            };
[492](#492)            Ok(Type::ConstInt(value))
[493](#493)        } else {
[494](#494)            Ok(Type::ConstBinary { op, left: std::rc::Rc::new(left), right: std::rc::Rc::new(right) })
[495](#495)        }
[496](#496)    }
[497](#497)
[498](#498)    pub fn comment(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
[499](#499)        if self.get()? == b'/' && self.ahead()? == b'/' {
[500](#500)            self.pos += 2;
[501](#501)            while self.pos < self.buf.len() && self.buf[self.pos] != b'\n' {
[502](#502)                self.pos += 1;
[503](#503)            }
[504](#504)            Ok(())
[505](#505)        } else if self.get()? == b'/' && self.ahead()? == b'*' {
[506](#506)            self.pos += 2;
[507](#507)            while self.pos + 1 < self.buf.len() {
[508](#508)                if self.buf[self.pos] == b'*' && self.buf[self.pos + 1] == b'/' {
[509](#509)                    self.pos += 2;
[510](#510)                    return Ok(());
[511](#511)                }
[512](#512)                self.pos += 1;
[513](#513)            }
[514](#514)            Err(ParserErr::at("未关闭的注释", self.pos).into())
[515](#515)        } else {
[516](#516)            Ok(())
[517](#517)        }
[518](#518)    }
[519](#519)
[520](#520)    pub fn whitespace(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
[521](#521)        while self.pos < self.buf.len() {
[522](#522)            self.comment()?;
[523](#523)            if self.pos >= self.buf.len() || !WHITE_SPACE.contains(&self.buf[self.pos]) {
[524](#524)                break;
[525](#525)            }
[526](#526)            self.pos += 1;
[527](#527)        }
[528](#528)        Ok(())
[529](#529)    }
[530](#530)
[531](#531)    pub fn ident(&mut self) -> Result<SmolStr> {
[532](#532)        let (start, mut stop) = self.collect(|ch| !NOT_IDENT.contains(&ch))?;
[533](#533)        loop {
[534](#534)            let save_pos = self.pos;
[535](#535)            if self.just("::").is_err() {
[536](#536)                break;
[537](#537)            }
[538](#538)            match self.collect(|ch| !NOT_IDENT.contains(&ch)) {
[539](#539)                Ok((_, next_stop)) => {
[540](#540)                    stop = next_stop;
[541](#541)                }
[542](#542)                Err(_) => {
[543](#543)                    self.pos = save_pos;
[544](#544)                    break;
[545](#545)                }
[546](#546)            }
[547](#547)        }
[548](#548)        if KEYWORDS.iter().position(|k| k.as_bytes() == &self.buf[start..stop]).is_some() {
[549](#549)            return Err(anyhow!("发现关键字{}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&self.buf[start..stop])));
[550](#550)        }
[551](#551)        Ok(self.get_str(start, stop))
[552](#552)    }
[553](#553)
[554](#554)    pub fn string(&mut self) -> Result<SmolStr> {
[555](#555)        if self.get()? != b'"' {
[556](#556)            return Err(ParserErr::at("非字符串", self.current_pos()).into());
[557](#557)        }
[558](#558)        self.pos += 1;
[559](#559)        let mut text_buf = Vec::new();
[560](#560)        while self.pos < self.buf.len() {
[561](#561)            if self.buf[self.pos] == b'\\' {
[562](#562)                self.pos += 1;
[564](#564)                match self.buf[self.pos] {
[565](#565)                    b'n' => {
[566](#566)                        text_buf.push(b'\n');
[567](#567)                        self.pos += 1;
[568](#568)                    }
[569](#569)                    b'r' => {
[570](#570)                        text_buf.push(b'\r');
[571](#571)                        self.pos += 1;
[572](#572)                    }
[573](#573)                    b't' => {
[574](#574)                        text_buf.push(b'\t');
[575](#575)                        self.pos += 1;
[576](#576)                    }
[577](#577)                    ch @ (b'\\' | b'"') => {
[578](#578)                        text_buf.push(ch);
[579](#579)                        self.pos += 1;
[580](#580)                    }
[581](#581)                    b'u' => {
[582](#582)                        self.pos += 1;
[583](#583)                        let unicode = if self.take(b'{').is_ok() {
[584](#584)                            let code = self.hex()?;
[585](#585)                            self.pos += 1;
[586](#586)                            code
[587](#587)                        } else {
[588](#588)                            self.hex()?
[589](#589)                        };
[590](#590)                        let ch = char::from_u32(unicode as u32).ok_or(anyhow!("非法 unicode {}", unicode))?;
[591](#591)                        let mut utf8_buf = [0u8; 4];
[592](#592)                        let s = ch.encode_utf8(&mut utf8_buf);
[593](#593)                        text_buf.extend_from_slice(s.as_bytes());
[594](#594)                    }
[595](#595)                    b'x' => {
[596](#596)                        self.pos += 1;
[597](#597)                        if self.pos + 2 > self.buf.len() {
[598](#598)                            return Err(anyhow!("非法 \\x 转义：需要 2 位十六进制"));
[599](#599)                        }
[600](#600)                        let start = self.pos;
[601](#601)                        self.pos += 2;
[602](#602)                        let hex = &self.buf[start..self.pos];
[603](#603)                        if hex.iter().any(|b| !b.is_ascii_hexdigit()) {
[604](#604)                            return Err(anyhow!("非法 \\x 转义：仅允许十六进制字符"));
[605](#605)                        }
[606](#606)                        let code = u32::from_str_radix(String::from_utf8_lossy(hex).as_ref(), 16)?;
[607](#607)                        if code > 0xFF {
[608](#608)                            return Err(anyhow!("\\x 转义值 0x{:02X} 超出 0xFF", code));
[609](#609)                        }
[610](#610)                        text_buf.push(code as u8);
[611](#611)                    }
[612](#612)                    other => {
[613](#613)                        return Err(anyhow!("invalid escape character: {}", other as char));
[614](#614)                    }
[615](#615)                }
[616](#616)            } else {
[617](#617)                if self.buf[self.pos] == b'"' {
[618](#618)                    self.pos += 1;
[619](#619)                    return Ok(String::from_utf8(text_buf)?.into());
[620](#620)                }
[621](#621)                text_buf.push(self.buf[self.pos]);
[622](#622)                self.pos += 1;
[623](#623)            }
[624](#624)        }
[625](#625)        Err(ParserErr::at("未关闭字符串", self.pos).into())
[626](#626)    }
[627](#627)
[628](#628)    pub fn text(&mut self) -> Result<SmolStr> {
[629](#629)        if self.get()? == b'r' && [b'#', b'"'].contains(&self.ahead()?) {
[630](#630)            self.pos += 1;
[631](#631)            let mut end = String::from("\"");
[632](#632)            while self.buf[self.pos] == b'#' {
[633](#633)                end.push('#');
[634](#634)                self.pos += 1;
[635](#635)            }
[636](#636)            if self.get()? != b'"' {
[637](#637)                return Err(ParserErr::at("非法的原始字符串", self.current_pos()).into());
[638](#638)            }
[639](#639)            self.pos += 1;
[640](#640)            let start_pos = self.pos;
[641](#641)            while self.pos < self.buf.len() {
[642](#642)                if self.just(&end).is_ok() {
[643](#643)                    break;
[644](#644)                }
[645](#645)                self.pos += 1;
[646](#646)            }
[647](#647)            Ok(self.get_str(start_pos, self.pos - end.len()))
[648](#648)        } else {
[649](#649)            self.string()
[650](#650)        }
[651](#651)    }
[652](#652)
[653](#653)    fn hex(&mut self) -> Result<i32> {
[654](#654)        let (start, stop) = self.collect(|ch| (ch >= b'0' && ch <= b'9') || (ch >= b'a' && ch <= b'f') || (ch >= b'A' && ch <= b'F'))?;
[656](#656)        Ok(i32::from_str_radix(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&self.buf[start..stop]), 16)?)
[657](#657)    }
[658](#658)
[659](#659)    fn numeric_suffix(&mut self) -> Option<Type> {
[660](#660)        let save = self.pos;
[661](#661)        for (name, ty) in TYPES {
[662](#662)            if !ty.is_native() {
[663](#663)                continue;
[664](#664)            }
[665](#665)            if self.buf.len() >= self.pos + name.len() && self.buf[self.pos..self.pos + name.len()].eq(name.as_bytes()) {
[666](#666)                self.pos += name.len();
[667](#667)                return Some(ty.clone());
[668](#668)            }
[669](#669)        }
[670](#670)        self.pos = save;
[671](#671)        None
[672](#672)    }

[674](#674)    fn int_literal(&mut self, digits: &str, radix: u32, suffix: Option<Type>) -> Result<Dynamic> {
[675](#675)        let ty = suffix.unwrap_or(Type::I64);
[677](#677)        let magnitude = u128::from_str_radix(digits, radix).map_err(|_| anyhow!("整数字面量 {} 超出可表示范围", digits))?;
[679](#679)        let (signed, bits) = match ty {
[680](#680)            Type::I8 => (true, 8u32),
[681](#681)            Type::I16 => (true, 16),
[682](#682)            Type::I32 => (true, 32),
[683](#683)            Type::I64 => (true, 64),
[684](#684)            Type::U8 => (false, 8),
[685](#685)            Type::U16 => (false, 16),
[686](#686)            Type::U32 => (false, 32),
[687](#687)            Type::U64 => (false, 64),
[688](#688)            Type::F16 => return Ok(Dynamic::F16(dynamic::f64_to_f16(magnitude as f64))),
[689](#689)            Type::F32 => return Ok(Dynamic::F32(magnitude as f32)),
[690](#690)            Type::F64 => return Ok(Dynamic::F64(magnitude as f64)),
[691](#691)            ty => return Err(anyhow!("{:?} 不能作为数字后缀", ty)),
[692](#692)        };
[693](#693)        let unsigned_max = (1u128 << bits) - 1;
[694](#694)        let max_allowed = if radix == 10 { if signed { unsigned_max / 2 + 1 } else { unsigned_max } } else { unsigned_max };
[697](#697)        if magnitude > max_allowed {
[698](#698)            return Err(anyhow!("整数字面量 {} 超出 {:?} 的范围", digits, ty));
[699](#699)        }
[700](#700)        Ok(match ty {
[701](#701)            Type::I8 => Dynamic::I8(magnitude as i8),
[702](#702)            Type::I16 => Dynamic::I16(magnitude as i16),
[703](#703)            Type::I32 => Dynamic::I32(magnitude as i32),
[704](#704)            Type::I64 => Dynamic::I64(magnitude as i64),
[705](#705)            Type::U8 => Dynamic::U8(magnitude as u8),
[706](#706)            Type::U16 => Dynamic::U16(magnitude as u16),
[707](#707)            Type::U32 => Dynamic::U32(magnitude as u32),
[708](#708)            Type::U64 => Dynamic::U64(magnitude as u64),
[709](#709)            _ => unreachable!(),
[710](#710)        })
[711](#711)    }
[712](#712)
[713](#713)    fn float_literal(&mut self, digits: &str, suffix: Option<Type>) -> Result<Dynamic> {
[714](#714)        let value: f64 = digits.parse()?;
[715](#715)        if let Some(ref ty) = suffix {
[716](#716)            let is_int_suffix = matches!(ty, Type::I8 | Type::I16 | Type::I32 | Type::I64 | Type::U8 | Type::U16 | Type::U32 | Type::U64);
[719](#719)            if is_int_suffix {
[720](#720)                let (min, max): (f64, f64) = match ty {
[721](#721)                    Type::I8 => (i8::MIN as f64, i8::MAX as f64),
[722](#722)                    Type::I16 => (i16::MIN as f64, i16::MAX as f64),
[723](#723)                    Type::I32 => (i32::MIN as f64, i32::MAX as f64),
[724](#724)                    Type::I64 => (i64::MIN as f64, i64::MAX as f64),
[725](#725)                    Type::U8 => (0.0, u8::MAX as f64),
[726](#726)                    Type::U16 => (0.0, u16::MAX as f64),
[727](#727)                    Type::U32 => (0.0, u32::MAX as f64),
[728](#728)                    Type::U64 => (0.0, u64::MAX as f64),
[729](#729)                    _ => unreachable!(),
[730](#730)                };
[731](#731)                if !value.is_finite() || value < min || value > max || value.fract() != 0.0 {
[732](#732)                    return Err(anyhow!("浮点字面量 {:?} 超出 {:?} 范围", value, ty));
[733](#733)                }
[734](#734)            } else if !value.is_finite() {
[735](#735)                return Err(anyhow!("非法浮点字面量: {:?}", value));
[736](#736)            }
[737](#737)        }
[738](#738)        Ok(match suffix.unwrap_or(Type::F32) {
[739](#739)            Type::I8 => Dynamic::I8(value as i8),
[740](#740)            Type::I16 => Dynamic::I16(value as i16),
[741](#741)            Type::I32 => Dynamic::I32(value as i32),
[742](#742)            Type::I64 => Dynamic::I64(value as i64),
[743](#743)            Type::U8 => Dynamic::U8(value as u8),
[744](#744)            Type::U16 => Dynamic::U16(value as u16),
[745](#745)            Type::U32 => Dynamic::U32(value as u32),
[746](#746)            Type::U64 => Dynamic::U64(value as u64),
[747](#747)            Type::F16 => Dynamic::F16(dynamic::f64_to_f16(value)),
[748](#748)            Type::F32 => Dynamic::F32(value as f32),
[749](#749)            Type::F64 => Dynamic::F64(value),
[750](#750)            ty => return Err(anyhow!("{:?} 不能作为浮点数字后缀", ty)),
[751](#751)        })
[752](#752)    }
[753](#753)
[754](#754)    pub fn number(&mut self) -> Result<Dynamic> {
[755](#755)        if self.get()? == b'0' {
[756](#756)            if [b'b', b'B'].contains(&self.ahead()?) {
[757](#757)                self.pos += 2;
[758](#758)                let (start, stop) = self.collect(|ch| ch == b'0' || ch == b'1')?;
[759](#759)                let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&self.buf[start..stop]).to_string();
[760](#760)                let suffix = self.numeric_suffix();
[761](#761)                return self.int_literal(&s, 2, suffix);
[762](#762)            } else if [b'o', b'O'].contains(&self.ahead()?) {
[763](#763)                self.pos += 2;
[764](#764)                let (start, stop) = self.collect(|ch| ch >= b'0' && ch <= b'7')?;
[765](#765)                let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&self.buf[start..stop]).to_string();
[766](#766)                let suffix = self.numeric_suffix();
[767](#767)                return self.int_literal(&s, 8, suffix);
[768](#768)            } else if [b'x', b'X'].contains(&self.ahead()?) {
[769](#769)                self.pos += 2;
[770](#770)                let (start, stop) = self.collect(|ch| (ch >= b'0' && ch <= b'9') || (ch >= b'a' && ch <= b'f') || (ch >= b'A' && ch <= b'F'))?;
[771](#771)                let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&self.buf[start..stop]).to_string();
[772](#772)                let suffix = self.numeric_suffix();
[773](#773)                return self.int_literal(&s, 16, suffix);
[774](#774)            }
[775](#775)        }
[776](#776)        let start = self.pos;
[777](#777)        while self.pos < self.buf.len() && self.buf[self.pos] <= b'9' && self.buf[self.pos] >= b'0' {
[778](#778)            self.pos += 1;
[779](#779)        }
[780](#780)        let mut is_float = false;
[781](#781)        if self.pos < self.buf.len() && self.buf[self.pos] == b'.' && self.ahead().map(|ch| ch <= b'9' && ch >= b'0').unwrap_or(false) {
[782](#782)            is_float = true;
[783](#783)            self.pos += 1;
[784](#784)            while self.pos < self.buf.len() && self.buf[self.pos] <= b'9' && self.buf[self.pos] >= b'0' {
[785](#785)                self.pos += 1;
[786](#786)            }
[787](#787)        }
[788](#788)        if self.pos < self.buf.len() && (self.buf[self.pos] == b'e' || self.buf[self.pos] == b'E') {
[789](#789)            let mut exp_pos = self.pos + 1;
[790](#790)            if exp_pos < self.buf.len() && (self.buf[exp_pos] == b'+' || self.buf[exp_pos] == b'-') {
[791](#791)                exp_pos += 1;
[792](#792)            }
[793](#793)            if exp_pos < self.buf.len() && self.buf[exp_pos] <= b'9' && self.buf[exp_pos] >= b'0' {
[794](#794)                is_float = true;
[795](#795)                self.pos = exp_pos + 1;
[796](#796)                while self.pos < self.buf.len() && self.buf[self.pos] <= b'9' && self.buf[self.pos] >= b'0' {
[797](#797)                    self.pos += 1;
[798](#798)                }
[799](#799)            }
[800](#800)        }
[801](#801)        if self.pos > start {
[802](#802)            let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&self.buf[start..self.pos]).to_string();
[803](#803)            let suffix = self.numeric_suffix();
[804](#804)            if is_float {
[805](#805)                return self.float_literal(&text, suffix);
[806](#806)            }
[807](#807)            return self.int_literal(&text, 10, suffix);
[808](#808)        }
[809](#809)        Err(ParserErr::at("非数字", start).into())
[810](#810)    }

[919](#919)    }
[920](#920)
[921](#921)    fn fmt_shape(expr: &crate::Expr) -> String {
[922](#922)        use crate::ExprKind::*;
[923](#923)        match &expr.kind {
[924](#924)            Value(v) => format!("{:?}", v).replace("I64(", "").replace("I32(", "").trim_end_matches(')').to_string(),
[925](#925)            Ident(name) => name.to_string(),
[926](#926)            Unary { op, value } => {
[927](#927)                let s = if matches!(op, crate::UnaryOp::Neg) { "-" } else { "!" };
[928](#928)                format!("({} {})", s, fmt_shape(value))
[929](#929)            }
[930](#930)            Binary { left, op, right } => format!("({} {} {})", binop_sym(op), fmt_shape(left), fmt_shape(right)),
[931](#931)            Range { start, stop, inclusive } => format!("({} {} {})", if *inclusive { "..=" } else { ".." }, fmt_shape(start), fmt_shape(stop)),
[932](#932)            Typed { value, ty } => format!("(as {} {:?})", fmt_shape(value), ty),
[933](#933)            other => format!("{:?}", other),
[934](#934)        }
[935](#935)    }

[1309](#1309)    #[test]
[1310](#1310)    fn parses_bigfloat_cmp_context_segment() {
[1311](#1311)        let code = r#"
[1312](#1312)            struct BigFloat<N> { data: [u32; N], exp: i32, sign: bool }
[1313](#1313)
[1314](#1314)            impl BigFloat<N> {
[1315](#1315)                fn abs_cmp(self: BigFloat<N>, rhs: BigFloat<N>) {
[1316](#1316)                    let self_high = self.exp + ((N - 1) as i32);
[1317](#1317)                    let rhs_high = rhs.exp + ((N - 1) as i32);
[1318](#1318)                    let high = if self_high >= rhs_high { self_high } else { rhs_high };
[1319](#1319)                    let low = if self.exp <= rhs.exp { self.exp } else { rhs.exp };
[1320](#1320)                    let result = 0i32;
[1321](#1321)                    let power = high;
[1322](#1322)
[1323](#1323)                    while power >= low && result == 0i32 {
[1324](#1324)                        let a_idx = power - self.exp;
[1325](#1325)                        let b_idx = power - rhs.exp;
[1326](#1326)                        let a_limb = 0u32;
[1327](#1327)                        let b_limb = 0u32;
[1328](#1328)
[1329](#1329)                        if a_idx >= 0i32 && a_idx < (N as i32) {
[1330](#1330)                            a_limb = self.data[a_idx as u32];
[1331](#1331)                        }
[1332](#1332)                        if b_idx >= 0i32 && b_idx < (N as i32) {
[1333](#1333)                            b_limb = rhs.data[b_idx as u32];
[1334](#1334)                        }
[1335](#1335)
[1336](#1336)                        if a_limb > b_limb {
[1337](#1337)                            result = 1i32;
[1338](#1338)                        } else if a_limb < b_limb {
[1339](#1339)                            result = -1i32;
[1340](#1340)                        }
[1341](#1341)
[1342](#1342)                        power -= 1i32;
[1343](#1343)                    }
[1344](#1344)
[1345](#1345)                    result
[1346](#1346)                }
[1347](#1347)
[1348](#1348)                pub fn cmp(self: BigFloat<N>, rhs: BigFloat<N>) {
[1349](#1349)                    if self.is_zero() && rhs.is_zero() {
[1350](#1350)                        0i32
[1351](#1351)                    } else if self.sign != rhs.sign {
[1352](#1352)                        if self.sign { -1i32 } else { 1i32 }
[1353](#1353)                    } else {
[1354](#1354)                        let cmp = self.abs_cmp(rhs);
[1355](#1355)                        if self.sign { -cmp } else { cmp }
[1356](#1356)                    }
[1357](#1357)                }
[1358](#1358)            }
[1359](#1359)            "#;
[1360](#1360)        parse_all(code).unwrap();
[1361](#1361)    }

在 ParserErr 基础上附带 parser 当前光标位置。 parse_code 顶层 downcast 此类型,做精确的 LSP-style 错误高亮。

Source: https://docs.rs/zust-parser/0.9.24/parser/constant.MAX_PARSE_DEPTH.html

`pub const MAX_PARSE_DEPTH: `[usize](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.usize.html) = 128;## Expand description

解析递归深度上限。超过即返回 [`ParserErr::TooDeep`],把“栈溢出崩溃“降级为
普通解析错误。

单层 `expr_with_min_weight` 帧约 7KB,worker 线程默认栈仅 2MB,因此上限取
128(与 rustc 默认 `recursion_limit` 一致):128×7KB≈0.9MB,在最小栈上仍有
余量,而正常代码极少超过几十层嵌套。

# bytemuck - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/bytemuck/^1.25.0/

## Expand description

This crate gives small utilities for casting between plain data types.

[§](https://docs.rs#basics)Basics

Data comes in five basic forms in Rust, so we have five basic casting functions:

- `T`uses- `cast`
- `&T`uses- `cast_ref`
- `&mut T`uses- `cast_mut`
- `&[T]`uses- `cast_slice`
- `&mut [T]`uses- `cast_slice_mut`

Depending on the function, the [ NoUninit](https://docs.rs/trait.NoUninit.html) and/or

[traits are used to maintain memory safety.](https://docs.rs/trait.AnyBitPattern.html)

`AnyBitPattern`**Historical Note:** When the crate first started the [ Pod](https://docs.rs/trait.Pod.html) trait was used
instead, and so you may hear people refer to that, but it has the strongest
requirements and people eventually wanted the more fine-grained system, so
here we are. All types that impl

`Pod` have a blanket impl to also support
`NoUninit` and `AnyBitPattern`. The traits unfortunately do not have a
perfectly clean hierarchy for semver reasons.[§](https://docs.rs#failures)Failures

Some casts will never fail, and other casts might fail.

- `cast::<u32, f32>`always works (and- `f32::from_bits`
- `cast_ref::<[u8; 4], u32>`might fail if the specific array reference given at runtime doesn’t have alignment 4.

In addition to the “normal” forms of each function, which will panic on
invalid input, there’s also `try_` versions which will return a `Result`.

If you would like to statically ensure that a cast will work at runtime you
can use the `must_cast` crate feature and the `must_` casting functions. A
“must cast” that can’t be statically known to be valid will cause a
compilation error (and sometimes a very hard to read compilation error).

[§](https://docs.rs#using-your-own-types)Using Your Own Types

All the functions listed above are guarded by the [ Pod](https://docs.rs/trait.Pod.html) trait, which is a
sub-trait of the

[trait.](https://docs.rs/trait.Zeroable.html)

`Zeroable`If you enable the crate’s `derive` feature then these traits can be derived
on your own types. The derive macros will perform the necessary checks on
your type declaration, and trigger an error if your type does not qualify.

The derive macros might not cover all edge cases, and sometimes they will
error when actually everything is fine. As a last resort you can impl these
traits manually. However, these traits are `unsafe`, and you should
carefully read the requirements before using a manual implementation.

[§](https://docs.rs#cargo-features)Cargo Features

The crate supports Rust 1.34 when no features are enabled, and so there’s cargo features for thing that you might consider “obvious”.

The cargo features **do not** promise any particular MSRV, and they may
increase their MSRV in new versions.

- `derive`: Provide derive macros for the various traits.
- `extern_crate_alloc`: Provide utilities for- `alloc`related types such as Box and Vec.
- `zeroable_maybe_uninit`and- `zeroable_atomics`: Provide more- `Zeroable`
- `pod_saturating`: Provide more- `Pod`- `Zeroable`
- `wasm_simd`and- `aarch64_simd`: Support more SIMD types.
- `min_const_generics`: Provides appropriate impls for arrays of all lengths instead of just for a select list of array lengths.
- `must_cast`: Provides the- `must_`functions, which will compile error if the requested cast can’t be statically verified.
- `const_zeroed`: Provides a const version of the- `zeroed`function.

[§](https://docs.rs#related-crates)Related Crates

- `pack1`- `bytemuck`-compatible packed little-endian, big-endian and native-endian integer and floating point number types.
